acwi_countries.title: ACWI country weights
acwi_countries.description: Live country weights of the iShares MSCI ACWI ETF, the benchmark for the country tilts. Reads FMP ETF country weighting.

bond_curve.title: Treasury curve, month-end since 2005
bond_curve.description: Month-end US Treasury yields from one month to 30 years since 2005. Built by Claude from FMP treasury rates.
bond_curve.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

bond_history.title: Bond ETF price history
bond_history.description: Daily dividend-adjusted closes since September 2023 for 27 bond ETFs; the call shown is SGOV’s and the same call runs for each of the others. Reads FMP dividend-adjusted EOD prices.

bond_quotes.title: Bond ETF quotes
bond_quotes.description: Live price, day change and 52-week range for 27 bond ETFs. Reads FMP batch quotes.

bond_stats.title: Bond ETF yields, duration and risk
bond_stats.description: For 27 bond ETFs: trailing and latest distribution yield, empirical duration and equity beta (weekly returns regressed on Treasury yield changes and US equities over three years), yield over duration-matched Treasury ETFs, annualized returns over 3 to 15 years, volatility, drawdowns, fees and assets. Built by Claude from FMP prices, dividends, ETF data and Treasury rates.
bond_stats.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

bt_candidates.title: Backtest: candidate metrics
bt_candidates.description: Metrics tested but not scored, with their backtested rank correlation, so the methodology tab can show why they were left out. Built by Claude from the backtest.
bt_candidates.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_honesty.title: Backtest confidence and costs
bt_honesty.description: Block-bootstrap 90% ranges for strategy excess returns and rank correlations, returns net of trading costs at 10 and 25 basis points a side, and how the default setting compares with all 70 tested. Computed by Claude. Each result is given twice: over the full history, and only from late 2021, when every fund has holdings as filed at the time.
bt_honesty.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_horizon.title: Backtest: weights by horizon
bt_horizon.description: Pillar weights for the 6-, 12- and 36-month horizon presets, from each pillar’s backtested rank correlation, shrunk halfway to equal weights. Built by Claude from the backtest.
bt_horizon.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_ic.title: Backtest rank correlations
bt_ic.description: Average monthly rank correlation between each score and returns over the following 1 to 36 months. Computed by Claude. Each result is given twice: over the full history, and only from late 2021, when every fund has holdings as filed at the time.
bt_ic.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_pairs.title: Backtest: theme pairs
bt_pairs.description: For ten style, size and region pairs, how often the side the composite preferred beat the other over the next 12 months, and by how much. Built by Claude from the backtest.
bt_pairs.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_performance.title: Backtest growth of 100
bt_performance.description: Monthly value of 100 invested in each backtested strategy and benchmark since 2015. Computed by Claude from the rebuilt model and FMP prices.
bt_performance.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_presets.title: Backtest by weight preset
bt_presets.description: Top- and bottom-fifth returns and rank correlations for each weight preset and sentiment reading. Computed by Claude. Each result is given twice: over the full history, and only from late 2021, when every fund has holdings as filed at the time.
bt_presets.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_quintiles.title: Backtest returns by score fifth
bt_quintiles.description: Average subsequent return of sleeves in each fifth of each score, by horizon. Computed by Claude. Each result is given twice: over the full history, and only from late 2021, when every fund has holdings as filed at the time.
bt_quintiles.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_regime.title: Backtest by regime
bt_regime.description: Average 12-month rank correlation of each pillar with later returns, and the top fifth's 12-month excess, in months grouped by the growth, inflation and financial conditions regime and by each axis. Computed by Claude.
bt_regime.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_robustness.title: Backtest: robustness
bt_robustness.description: Rank correlations and top-fifth excess returns with holdings as filed at the time versus today's holdings, over the full period and the fully filed window. Computed by Claude.
bt_robustness.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_rolling.title: Backtest rolling excess
bt_rolling.description: Rolling three-year annualized return of selected strategies minus the ACWI. Computed by Claude.
bt_rolling.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_settings.title: Backtest: every setting
bt_settings.description: For each weight preset, sentiment reading and valuation basis, the average 12-month return of each score fifth over the universe average and the full-period return of a monthly top fifth, since 2015. Computed by Claude from FMP prices, quarterly financials and the funds’ SEC holdings filings. Each result is given twice: over the full history, and only from late 2021, when every fund has holdings as filed at the time.
bt_settings.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_stats.title: Backtest statistics
bt_stats.description: Annual return, volatility, drawdown, excess return, hit rate and turnover for each backtested strategy. Computed by Claude. Each result is given twice: over the full history, and only from late 2021, when every fund has holdings as filed at the time.
bt_stats.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

bt_valuation.title: Backtest: valuation methods
bt_valuation.description: Rank correlation of each valuation method (across the universe, own history, within category, blend) with subsequent returns, by horizon and region. Computed by Claude.
bt_valuation.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

calendar_live.title: Economic calendar, live
calendar_live.description: Major-country economic releases with high or medium expected impact from yesterday through the next ten days, with consensus and actuals as they print. Reads the FMP economic calendar.

call_index.title: Earnings-call readings
call_index.description: Tone, tone against each company's own history, net guidance and topic mentions across S&P 500 earnings calls in the past three months, monthly since 2014, with this quarter's biggest tone moves among the largest companies. Scored by Claude from FMP earnings call transcripts.
call_index.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

call_meta.title: Earnings-call company names
call_meta.description: Name and sector for every company with a scored earnings call: S&P 500 members from FMP, holdings from the universe data, and former members from their FMP profiles.
call_meta.schedule: Rebuilt every Saturday by the weekly refresh (profiles.py)

call_scores.title: Scored earnings calls
call_scores.description: Tone and topic scores for every S&P 500 earnings call since 2014 that FMP has a transcript for (no transcript text), kept so each week only new calls are scored. Scored by Claude.
call_scores.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

call_sleeves.title: Earnings calls by fund
call_sleeves.description: Holdings-weighted earnings-call tone change, guidance and main topics for each fund's US holdings over the past 100 days. Scored by Claude from FMP earnings call transcripts.
call_sleeves.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

call_tests.title: Earnings-call signal tests
call_tests.description: Rank correlations of the earnings-call readings with later stock returns, growth and inflation, on non-overlapping periods before 2019 and from 2020, and whether each passed the promotion rule. Computed by Claude from FMP transcripts and prices.
call_tests.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

commentary.title: Commentary
commentary.description: Week in Review, The Week Ahead, Month in Review, Quarter in Review and earnings-call takeaways, written by Claude from this dashboard’s FMP and FRED data. One row per piece: id, kind, title, headline, period, date, asOf, body (Markdown).
commentary.schedule: Appended by Claude after Friday’s close, on Sunday afternoons, and after each month’s and quarter’s last close

constituent_quotes.title: Holdings live quotes
constituent_quotes.description: Live price, 50/200-day averages and 52-week range for every holding used in the look-through, fetched in groups of 150; the call shown is the first group. Reads FMP batch quotes.

constituent_series.title: Holdings history, quarterly
constituent_series.description: Quarterly trailing multiples, ROE, net margin and price for each fund's 25 largest holdings since 2014. Built by Claude from FMP quarterly ratios, key metrics and prices.
constituent_series.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

constituents.title: Holdings fundamentals
constituents.description: Per-company TTM ratios and key metrics, annual consensus EPS and revenue for the last, current and next fiscal year, consensus price targets and analyst grades for every holding in the look-through. Snapshot of FMP ratios-ttm, key-metrics-ttm, analyst-estimates, price-target-consensus, grades-consensus and profile.
constituents.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

country_risk.title: Country risk premiums
country_risk.description: Country risk premium and total equity risk premium for each country fund's market from FMP, against the United States. Built by Claude.
country_risk.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

cp_income.title: Company lookup: income
cp_income.description: FMP annual income statements, last six years, for the ticker typed on the Company profile page.

cp_metrics.title: Company lookup: key metrics
cp_metrics.description: FMP trailing-twelve-month key metrics (EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, ROIC, leverage) for the ticker typed on the Company profile page.

cp_profile.title: Company lookup: profile
cp_profile.description: FMP company profile for the ticker typed on the Company profile page, when it is outside the prepared 300.

cp_px.title: Company lookup: prices
cp_px.description: FMP daily closing prices since October 2021 for the ticker typed on the Company profile page.

dq_report.title: Data checks
dq_report.description: Flags raised when the snapshot is rebuilt: unusable or partial holdings files, thin data coverage, implausible multiples, estimates that do not reconcile with trailing EPS, and multiples that disagree with their own history. Computed by Claude.
dq_report.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

estimate_history.title: Consensus estimate snapshots
estimate_history.description: Weekly snapshots of consensus EPS for the current and next fiscal year for every holding, saved from FMP since October 2026 because FMP keeps no estimate history. The revision metrics are measured against these.
estimate_history.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

etf_extras.title: ETF costs and flows
etf_extras.description: Each ETF’s expense ratio, assets, and net creation or redemption of shares over six and twelve months, as a share of assets. Built by Claude from FMP ETF information and market-cap history.
etf_extras.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

etf_history.title: ETF price history
etf_history.description: Daily dividend-adjusted closes since September 2023 for every sleeve ETF; the call shown is SPY's and the same call runs for each of the others. Reads FMP dividend-adjusted EOD prices.

etf_quotes.title: ETF live quotes
etf_quotes.description: Live price, day change, 50/200-day averages and 52-week range for the 62 sleeve ETFs. Reads FMP batch quotes.

etf_universe.title: Sleeve universe
etf_universe.description: The 62 building blocks with their ETF proxy, benchmark, group, region, country, look-through coverage and price on the snapshot date. Built by Claude from FMP ETF holdings and quotes.
etf_universe.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

etf_weekly.title: ETF weekly prices since 2005
etf_weekly.description: Weekly dividend-adjusted closes for every sleeve ETF since 2005 (or since the fund started), for long-range charts and returns. Built by Claude from FMP dividend-adjusted EOD prices.
etf_weekly.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

fund_holdings.title: ETF top holdings
fund_holdings.description: Each ETF's largest holdings and weights, as reported by FMP (IWN uses VTWV, which tracks the same Russell 2000 Value index). Snapshot of FMP ETF holdings.
fund_holdings.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

fund_sectors.title: Fund sector make-up
fund_sectors.description: Sector weights of every fund the model portfolio can hold, including all 62 equity sleeves: GICS-style sectors for the equity funds (FMP ETF sector weightings, or the look-through holdings where FMP has none); for bond funds, the bond type and, for corporates, the issuer industry. Cash dropped and the rest rescaled.
fund_sectors.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

fx.title: Currencies: valuation and trend
fx.description: Each currency in the universe against the US dollar: the dollar price of one unit, the 12-month change, and a purchasing-power valuation (World Bank PPP price level relative to peers, net of the dollar’s). Built by Claude from FMP exchange rates and World Bank PPP factors.
fx.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

fx_history.title: Currency price history
fx_history.description: Daily closes since September 2023 for twelve currencies against the dollar; the call shown is the euro's and the same call runs for each of the others. Reads FMP forex end-of-day prices.

fx_model.title: Currency models
fx_model.description: Cyclical (rates, carry, growth surprises, the 10-year yield gap, trend, positioning, risk) and long-term (real exchange rate value, real rates) scores for 14 currencies, the dollar index and an EM basket, with candidate signals tested weekly, monthly fair values (value model and PPP), suggested hedge ratios, signal rank correlations and backtests rebalanced monthly, quarterly and half-yearly. Built by Claude from FMP forex prices, policy rates, the macro record, CFTC positioning and OECD yields.
fx_model.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

fx_stats.title: Currencies against the dollar
fx_stats.description: Twelve developed and emerging currencies: returns from one month to ten years, the level against the 10-year average and against World Bank purchasing-power parity, the 200-day trend, a suggested hedge ratio for developed currencies, and a 52-week weekly sparkline. Built by Claude from FMP forex history.
fx_stats.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

global_yields.title: Government yields abroad
global_yields.description: 10-year government bond yields and 3-month interbank rates for the US and 14 other markets, monthly averages from the OECD series on FRED.
global_yields.schedule: Rebuilt every week by a scheduled task

insider_sleeves.title: Insider activity by fund
insider_sleeves.description: Company insiders' open-market purchases against sales over the last two quarters, weighted across each fund's US-listed holdings, from FMP insider trading statistics, with coverage. Built by Claude.
insider_sleeves.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

lab_experiments.title: Saved lab experiments
lab_experiments.description: Model-lab experiments saved for everyone, with who asked for each, when, its settings and its backtest result, refreshed weekly; also the log of experiments made the published model. Kept by Claude.
lab_experiments.schedule: Updated when an experiment is saved, and every week by a scheduled task

lab_inputs.title: Model lab signal history
lab_inputs.description: Every signal in the stocks vs bonds, fixed income and real assets models, live or evidence only, as known at each month-end since 2008, with the next month's returns of the funds the models hold. Built by Claude from FMP data for the model lab.
lab_inputs.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

lab_log.title: Lab experiments' weekly calls
lab_log.description: Each week's current calls (equity weight, fixed income positions, real asset shares) for the published settings and every saved experiment, kept for their live records. Appended by Claude.
lab_log.schedule: Appended every week by a scheduled task

lab_spec.title: Model lab settings
lab_spec.description: The published settings of the three allocation models (which signals are on, pillar weights, position sizes, the real assets threshold) and their published backtest results, for the model lab. Built by Claude.
lab_spec.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

macro_history.title: US rates and risk premiums
macro_history.description: Month-end US Treasury yields, CPI inflation and the real 10-year yield, recession probability, the dollar (UUP), high yield against Treasuries (HYG/IEF), ACWI's trend, regime labels, and the cycle-adjusted earnings yield and equity risk premium of the global, US, developed ex-US and emerging sleeves since 2010. The single source for the real yield and equity risk premium used across the dashboard. Built by Claude from FMP treasury rates, economic indicators and prices.
macro_history.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

macro_px.title: Macro proxies, daily
macro_px.description: Daily closes since September 2024 for the dollar (UUP), high yield (HYG), 7-10 year Treasuries (IEF), oil (USO), gold (GLD) and the VIX; the call shown is UUP’s and the same call runs for each of the others. Reads FMP dividend-adjusted EOD prices (EOD light for the VIX).

macro_state.title: Macro state and regime
macro_state.description: Growth, inflation and financial conditions scored against their own history from FMP economic indicators, the economic calendar, CPI, policy rate decisions, Treasury rates and market prices; the regime probabilities, the latest releases and surprises, the coming week's calendar, policy rates and monthly history since 2001. Built by Claude.
macro_state.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

model_bt.title: Model backtests: real assets and the models together
model_bt.description: Monthly backtests of the real assets sleeve (model-chosen against every asset at equal risk, inside a 60/40) since 2009, and of the stocks vs bonds weight and fixed income tilts run together against a static 60/40, with 90% ranges and growth-of-100 series. Built by Claude.
model_bt.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

model_fi.title: Fixed income relative value model
model_fi.description: Eight tilts against the US Aggregate (including hedged international bonds) with their signals, positions, the input levels that would make each neutral or full size, results by backdrop, and a backtest since December 2010. Built by Claude from FMP bond ETF prices and yields, Treasury rates, CPI and OECD yields abroad.
model_fi.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

model_log.title: Saved weekly calls
model_log.description: Each Saturday’s stocks vs bonds weight, fixed income tilts and their pair funds, real asset scores, private markets calls, equity preferences, regime, macro axes and currency views, plus the observations behind them (‘obs’), kept for the live records and the Executive summary’s change table. Appended by Claude every week.
model_log.schedule: Appended every week by a scheduled task

model_pm.title: Private markets (listed proxies)
model_pm.description: Relative-value calls on listed proxies for private markets: BDCs (BIZD) against high yield and listed private equity (PSP) against global equities, with the BDC discount to book value. Built by models.py.
model_pm.schedule: Rebuilt every week by a scheduled task

model_ra.title: Real assets and alternatives model
model_ra.description: Gold, broad commodities, US REITs, global infrastructure, managed futures, copper, energy pipelines and Bitcoin scored as diversifiers for a 60/40 portfolio, each on trend, diversification and its own signals under the promotion rule, with sleeve shares weighted by score over volatility (at most 35% each), each score’s monthly history and its rank correlation with the next year’s return over 60/40. Proxies fill early history for managed futures and copper. Built by Claude from FMP prices and the macro record.
model_ra.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

model_sb.title: Stocks vs bonds model
model_sb.description: The current equity weight for a global equities and US bonds portfolio around a 60/40 neutral, from the signals that pass the promotion rule (now applied to every signal), with every other signal shown; the point-in-time US equity risk premium; what would change the call; results by regime; and a backtest split into the excess from sitting above neutral and the excess from timing. Built by Claude from FMP prices, Treasury rates, CPI, S&P 500 members' filings, the economic calendar and CFTC positioning.
model_sb.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

multi_history.title: Other-asset price history
multi_history.description: Daily dividend-adjusted closes since September 2023 for REITs, infrastructure, MLPs, commodities, currencies, bitcoin and the alternatives (managed futures, BDCs, listed private equity, uranium miners); the call shown is VNQ’s and the same call runs for each of the others. Reads FMP dividend-adjusted EOD prices.

multi_quotes.title: Other-asset quotes
multi_quotes.description: Live quotes for REITs, infrastructure, MLPs, commodities, currencies, bitcoin and the alternatives (managed futures, BDCs, listed private equity, uranium miners). Reads FMP batch quotes.

multi_stats.title: Multi-asset long-run returns
multi_stats.description: For 39 assets across equities, bonds, credit, real assets, commodities, alternatives, currencies and bitcoin, plus a 60/40 blend: annualized returns over 3 to 20 years, volatility, worst drawdown, calendar-year returns and three-year correlations with global equities and US bonds. Built by Claude from FMP dividend-adjusted prices.
multi_stats.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

pack_link.title: Committee pack
pack_link.description: Date and link of this week's committee pack PDF: the weekly note, the model calls and the main charts. Built by Claude every week.
pack_link.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

pipeline_checks.title: Pipeline checks
pipeline_checks.description: Results of the checks run at the end of every weekly rebuild: outputs present, fresh and within size limits, the signal registry agreeing with the models, the weekly note agreeing with the models, and no credentials in uploaded files. Written by checks.py.
pipeline_checks.schedule: Rebuilt every week by a scheduled task

pit_val.title: Point-in-time S&P 500 valuation
pit_val.description: Monthly since 2004: the S&P 500's trailing and five-year cycle-adjusted earnings yields, summed over the companies in the index on each date using only earnings already filed, and the equity risk premium against the real 10-year yield, with how many members FMP covers. Built by Claude from FMP income statements, market values, index changes, CPI and Treasury rates.
pit_val.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

positioning.title: Futures positioning
positioning.description: Speculators' net position as a share of open interest in 23 futures contracts from the CFTC Commitments of Traders reports in FMP, with how extreme each is against the past three years, weekly since 2008 and monthly history. Built by Claude.
positioning.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

profiles.title: Company profiles, top 300
profiles.description: For the 300 largest holdings by combined weight across the universe: FMP profile, five years of annual and eight quarters of income statements, cash flow, balance sheet, key metrics, analyst estimates, earnings results against estimates, peers and five years of weekly prices.
profiles.schedule: Rebuilt every Saturday by the weekly refresh (profiles.py)

rates_credit.title: Inflation, real yields, credit
rates_credit.description: Treasury breakeven inflation (5-year, 10-year, 5y5y forward), TIPS real yields (5, 10, 30 years), nominal Treasury yields, ICE BofA option-adjusted spreads and total-return indexes for US investment grade and high yield by rating, from FRED. Breakevens and real yields since 2003; ICE series cover the past three years, the history FRED serves.
rates_credit.schedule: Rebuilt from FRED by the weekly refresh (fred.py) and by each commentary run

regime_playbook.title: Regime playbook
regime_playbook.description: Average next-month return, hit rate and volatility of each fund and model sleeve in each growth, inflation and financial conditions state since 2001, using only the state known at each month-end. Built by Claude from FMP prices and the macro state history.
regime_playbook.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

risk_model.title: Fund risk model
risk_model.description: Annualized covariances of monthly returns over the last five years for every fund the model portfolio can hold (all 62 equity sleeves, ACWI, the bond funds, real assets, alternatives and the dollar), and each fund’s sensitivity to global equities, the 10-year yield, the dollar and oil. Built by Claude from FMP prices and Treasury yields.
risk_model.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

score_history.title: Score snapshots
score_history.description: Every sleeve's pillar scores and composites for each weight preset and sentiment reading, saved by Claude each time the fundamentals snapshot is rebuilt.
score_history.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

sensitivities.title: Macro sensitivities
sensitivities.description: Each sleeve’s 60-month regression on global equities (ACWI), the change in the 10-year Treasury yield, the dollar (UUP) and oil (USO), plus beta, downside and upside capture and residual volatility. Built by Claude from FMP prices and treasury rates.
sensitivities.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

signal_registry.title: Signal registry
signal_registry.description: Every signal in the stocks vs bonds, fixed income, real assets, private markets and currency models with its rank correlation with next-year returns before 2019 and from 2020, months used, and whether it passed the promotion rule into the live model or stays evidence only. Built by Claude.
signal_registry.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

sleeve_series.title: Sleeve history, monthly
sleeve_series.description: Each sleeve at every month-end: price since 2005, and since 2015 the rebuilt look-through multiples, quality metrics, breadth and pillar scores. Built by Claude from FMP prices and quarterly ratios and key metrics, using each fund's holdings as filed with the SEC at the time.
sleeve_series.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

surprise.title: Economic surprises
surprise.description: Weekly growth and inflation surprise indices by region since mid-2014: each release's actual against consensus from the FMP economic calendar, scaled by that indicator's own surprise history and smoothed. Built by Claude.
surprise.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP every week by a scheduled task

today_earnings.title: Large-company earnings
today_earnings.description: The 40 largest US companies reporting earnings in the past week or the next ten days, with expected and actual EPS. Reads the FMP earnings calendar and batch quotes.

today_news.title: Market headlines
today_news.description: The latest general market headlines from FMP (250 asked for), kept only from major financial outlets: WSJ, CNBC, Reuters, MarketWatch, Barron’s, Fox Business, Bloomberg, ZeroHedge and similar. The public copy of the dashboard adds Bloomberg, ZeroHedge, Fox Business, CNBC and WSJ headlines from their RSS feeds.

today_px.title: Cross-asset price history
today_px.description: Daily closes since January 2024 for the 45 priced assets on the Today page: dividend-adjusted for funds, plain closes for futures, currencies, the VIX and crypto. The call shown is SPY’s and the same call runs for each of the others. Reads FMP EOD prices.

today_quotes.title: Cross-asset live quotes
today_quotes.description: Live price for every fund, future, currency, the VIX and crypto on the Today page. Reads FMP batch quotes.

treasury.title: US Treasury yields, daily
treasury.description: Daily 3-month, 2-year and 10-year Treasury yields over about fifteen months. FMP returns three months per call, so the call shown runs for five consecutive windows. Reads FMP treasury rates.

val_history.title: Valuation history by sleeve
val_history.description: Each sleeve's monthly look-through trailing P/E, cycle-adjusted P/E, EV/EBITDA, P/B, free cash flow and dividend yields and net margin since 2015, as 21 quantiles, plus its five-year average earnings, for the own-history and cycle-adjusted valuation reads. Built by Claude from FMP quarterly financials and the funds' SEC holdings filings.
val_history.schedule: Rebuilt from FMP on the first scheduled refresh of each month

weekly_note.title: Weekly committee note
weekly_note.description: The model’s weekly summary in short bullets: bottom line, the week in markets, preferences and avoids with the evidence behind them, a line per category, what is changing, style and region calls, changes since last week, and risks. Written by Claude from this week’s data and backtest.
weekly_note.schedule: Rewritten every week by a scheduled task

xasset_weekly.title: Cross-asset weekly history
xasset_weekly.description: Weekly closes since 2005–07 for bond ETFs, real-asset, commodity and alternative funds (managed futures, BDCs, listed private equity, uranium miners), commodity futures, the dollar index, twelve currencies (US dollars per unit), bitcoin, ether and the VIX, from FMP; dividend-adjusted for funds. Long history for Compare & correlate, Relative trends and the currency pair explorer.
xasset_weekly.schedule: Rebuilt every Saturday by the weekly refresh (xasset_hist.py)
